ask.introSell: Ask a question about selling. Only you see the answer.
ask.noAdvice: The assistant gives no advice. It only picks answers from the FAQ.
ask.example1Sell: How do I list a card?
ask.example2Sell: What does the AI draft cost?
ask.example3Sell: How do I find the opening price?
ask.wrongAnswer: Was that the right answer? If not, rephrase the question or read the FAQ.

ask.rate: Too many questions in a short time. Please wait a moment.

no_advice.a: I do not give advice on that. Whether you bid or sell is your own decision. For legal, tax or financial questions please ask a qualified person.

cannot.a: I cannot answer that. Please read the FAQ or write to us.

room_assistant.a: The assistant picks the matching answer from our fixed FAQ for your question. It does not make up answers, gives no investment, legal or tax advice and knows no personal data. Only you see its answer.

live_now.q: Which lot is on now, what is the bid and how long is left?
live_now.a: The current lot, the highest bid and the time left are shown at the top of the stage. The current values of this room are shown below.

sell_how.q: How do I list a card?
sell_how.a: Open Sell, choose a card from your wallet, set the opening price and the time, and publish. The card stays in your wallet until it is sold. After the hammer you must be online to sign the payment.

sell_draft.q: What does the AI draft do?
sell_draft.a: It suggests a title and a description for your card. The text is labelled as an AI draft, you review it and adopt it yourself. Without AI access you get a template at no cost.

sell_credits.q: What do the AI drafts cost?
sell_credits.a: A pack of 10 drafts costs 1 USDC (on the test network, test USDC with no value). You pay with one transaction that you confirm in your wallet. If a draft fails it is refunded. Templates cost nothing.

sell_photos.a: Photos go to Google only for the AI draft. They are shrunk in your browser first, without location data, and we do not store them.

sell_price.q: How do I find the opening price?
sell_price.a: You set the opening price yourself. If you enter your own estimate in the AI draft, we suggest 45 percent of it. That is not a valuation of the card. The reserve is optional: if the highest bid stays below it, the card is not sold.

ask.liveNone: No lot is running right now.
ask.published: Published in the chat, labelled as AI.
ask.publishNote: As the operator you can make this answer visible to everyone through the moderated chat.
ask.publishRefused: Refused by the chat rules (for example a link). Rephrase the question or write it in the chat yourself.

gate.title: Connect your wallet to use the AI
gate.body: Every AI function here needs a signed-in wallet: the agent, the listing draft and the assistant in the rooms. Without one, nothing is sent to the AI and nothing costs anything.
